content:
Apple yesterday launched the all-new Apple Watch Ultra 4 and Apple Watch Series 12 lineup, along with the new AirPods 5, which will go on sale next Friday, September 18.

Before the official launch, Apple's new products are already available for pre-order on Amazon.

AirPods 5

First, the new Apple AirPods 5 offer further enhanced features while pricing is even more affordable. Both AirPods 5 models now come with Active Noise Cancellation (ANC), which sets them apart from the previous-generation AirPods 4. However, there are some differences between the two models — the lower-tier model lacks on-device volume controls and does not include a wireless charging case. The higher-tier model, on the other hand, offers approximately one additional hour of battery life.

I spent several hours trying out the AirPods 5 and was genuinely impressed by the improved ANC performance — I'll share more detailed impressions later.

Apple Watch Series 12

On the other hand, the all-new Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4 both feature major upgrades in health tracking. Apple calls this system the new "Health Sensing System," which enables higher-frequency heart rate and heart rate variability (HRV) sensing, thereby supporting a brand-new "Readiness" scoring feature. The system also adds several new Audio Intelligence features, including Live Rewind and Siri Recap.

  • Apple Watch Series 12 42mm $399
  • Apple Watch Series 12 46mm $449
  • Apple Watch Series 12 42mm GPS + Cellular $490 (original price $499)
  • Apple Watch Series 12 46mm GPS + Cellular $549
  • Apple Watch Series 12 42mm Titanium $699
  • Apple Watch Series 12 46mm Titanium $729 (original price $749)
  • Apple Watch Series 12 46mm Ceramic $949

New Apple Watch band colors

Finally, several new Apple Watch bands are also on sale on Amazon. I tried out the new colors for a while and particularly liked the new translucent Ocean Band style.

  • New Trail Loop $99 — Sand, Dark Brown, Wine Red
  • New Ocean Band $99 — Translucent Seaweed Green, Grey, Black
  • New Alpine Loop $99 — Desert, Dark Olive Green, Wine Red
